resources.string: Warns with tones, a spoken sentence and a pop-up over CarPlay before you reach a speed camera, using the car\'s own GPS. Keeps running in the background over any app, with or without the iPhone connected. Camera locations come from OpenStreetMap and update when the car has internet. Needs precise location and \"display over other apps\".
Says the distance and the speed limit after the tones.
Keeps a small card with your speed and the next camera over every screen. Drag it anywhere; hold it to mark a camera that is missing.
Updating the camera list at the next position…
Could not reach the camera server. The saved list is still used.
No cameras downloaded yet. They download as soon as the car has internet.
Allow \"display over other apps\" for the pop-up. Without it, alerts come as notifications.
